# Code of Conduct

Paroh exists to help people through genuinely difficult periods of their lives — anxiety, depression, and the quiet work of healing from both. We ask contributors to bring that same care to how they treat each other here.

## Expected

- Be respectful in issues, PRs, and discussions, including when disagreeing about a technical or product decision
- Assume good faith — most disagreements here are about trade-offs, not right vs. wrong
- Give feedback on the work, not the person
- Respect that some contributors may be building this partly for their own healing, and that context deserves gentleness, not exploitation

## Not Acceptable

- Harassment, personal attacks, or discriminatory language of any kind
- Dismissive or mocking responses to genuine questions, especially from newer contributors
- Pressuring anyone to share personal mental-health experiences to justify a design opinion — lived experience is welcome when offered, never required
- Any attempt to use this project or its community to target, identify, or harm real people, including other contributors

## Enforcement

Violations can be reported to the project maintainer(s). Responses may range from a private conversation to removal from the project, depending on severity and pattern. We'd rather resolve things directly and kindly than escalate — but we will act when needed to keep this a safe space to build in.

## Scope

This applies to all project spaces — issues, PRs, discussions, and any other official Paroh community space.
